name: Split — the planner never implements
description: Plan and implement are distinct workers: the plan stage has no outgoing transition, so a planner can only hand off to a freshly spawned implementer.

plan.description: Spawn and brief a plan worker; on its wake approve, reject with feedback, answer its question, or abandon. You do **not** approve into implement — this planner never writes code, and the handoff to one that does is yours to make.

implement.description: A fresh worker, not the planner — it starts with no context, so its brief carries the plan's substance, not a pointer to it. Put it on the planner's worktree: one branch stays one merge unit, and it inherits the base the plan was written against. Retire the planner (`kill_instance`) once you have the plan — that clears the shared-worktree hazard before it exists.

review.description: Spawn an adversarial reviewer onto the implementer's worktree, briefed to inspect only — never edit, stage or commit — to default to skepticism, and to answer `REVIEW_CLEAN` or a findings list. Never prompt it and the implementer in the same turn: they share one worktree.

refine.description: Relay only the findings worth fixing to the implementer; on its refined wake send the same reviewer back. You arbitrate each round — worth fixing → refine again, else land; escalate only on a call you cannot resolve.
